pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal to rounded dark regions with diffuse, soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patches exhibit moderate spatial area with increased density and reduced size at the transition from the neck to the shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid-like network of light pathways. Topology is characterized by tri-nodal and tetra-nodal junction nodes. Pixel thickness of corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible flank and neck surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-frequency, irregular jagged silhouette along the upper neck mane. Amplitude of the serration is low, appearing as a soft, dark-colored fringe against the background pixels.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct concave discontinuity in the continuous mane line is visible at the anatomical junction between the lower neck and the dorsal shoulder ridge.
